description: This Java source file defines a class OpenmrsMetadataHandler that extends DefaultMetadataHandler. It provides custom implementations for checking if a database table exists and retrieving tables, specifically tailored to the OpenMRS project settings.

classes.name: OpenmrsMetadataHandler
classes.description: A handler class extending DefaultMetadataHandler, customized for OpenMRS database metadata operations such as verifying table existence and fetching table lists.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks whether a table exists in the database by using DatabaseMetaData. It returns true if the ResultSet from getTables has any entries.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves a ResultSet of tables from DatabaseMetaData, filtering by schema and table types, with a wildcard for table name to fetch all tables of specified types.
